biography.plain_text: Enrique Ortiz Selfa is a Spanish property developer based in Alicante. He inherited his father's construction business and expanded it into Grupo Cívica, encompassing building, land development and municipal services. Born in Grañén, Huesca, he represents the third generation of a business family established by his grandfather, Tomás Ortiz Cerdá.

long_biography.plain_text:
In 2019, Enrique Ortiz Selfa handed executive responsibility at Grupo Cívica, his construction and property group, to his children, formalising a succession already under way. Laura and Enrique Ortiz Carratalá took leading roles, while their father withdrew from day-to-day management. The shift coincided with Cívica reducing its exposure to public works and concessions and concentrating on residential development.

Ortiz's involvement in Hércules CF began with his acquisition of the Alicante club in 1999. He briefly served as its president and has remained involved in its leadership as an owner. He has selected club presidents, intervened in coaching decisions and determined financial support for the playing squad.

In 2019, Enrique Ortiz Selfa handed executive responsibility at Grupo Cívica, his construction and property group, to his children, formalising a succession already under way. The shift coincided with Cívica reducing its exposure to public works and concessions and concentrating on residential development.

Ortiz's involvement in Hércules CF began with his acquisition of the Alicante club in 1999. He briefly served as its president and has remained involved in its leadership as an owner. He has selected club presidents, intervened in coaching decisions and determined financial support for the playing squad.
